note: Views EF Fieldset is a Views display-extender plugin (id views_ef_fieldset, class ViewsEFFieldset extends DefaultDisplayExtender) that groups a view's exposed filters/sorts/buttons into nested containers (container | details/Fieldset | vertical_tabs). It has no admin settings page (configure=null); all config is per view at display.<id>.display_options.display_extenders.views_ef_fieldset.views_ef_fieldset with keys enabled (bool) and options.sort (a flat map of items keyed by id, each with id, pid parent, weight, depth, type of container|filter|sort|buttons, and for containers container_type/title/description/open). At render, hook_form_views_exposed_form_alter rebuilds $form['filters']['children'] from that tree. Medium/hard cases use a namespaced view 'vef_test' built from the module's shipped test view, exercising that real config path.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal views_ef_fieldset module do, and where in the Views UI do I turn it on for a view?
evals.expected_output: It groups a view's exposed form widgets (filters, sorts, buttons) into fieldsets/containers/vertical tabs. It is a Views display extender with no settings page; you enable it on the view's Exposed form settings via the 'Enable fieldset around exposed forms?' checkbox and build the grouping in the drag table.

evals.prompt: In views_ef_fieldset, when I add a container to group exposed filters, what container types can I choose, and what render element does each produce?
evals.expected_output: A container's container_type can be 'container' (a plain div), 'details' (a collapsible Fieldset, honoring the open flag), or 'vertical_tabs'. These become the corresponding Form API #type on the rebuilt exposed form.

evals.prompt: Where is a views_ef_fieldset grouping stored in a Drupal view's configuration, and which top-level keys hold the on/off flag and the arrangement of items?
evals.expected_output: In the view config under display.<display_id>.display_options.display_extenders.views_ef_fieldset.views_ef_fieldset, with 'enabled' (bool) and 'options.sort' (a flat map of items keyed by id, each with id/pid/weight/depth/type and, for containers, container_type/title/open).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a view with machine name 'vef_test' that uses views_ef_fieldset. Inspect its configuration and tell me the title configured for the root (top-level) fieldset container of its exposed form grouping.
evals.expected_output: The root container title is 'vef_root_marker': in views.view.vef_test at display.default.display_options.display_extenders.views_ef_fieldset.views_ef_fieldset.options.sort.root.title. Read with drush cget views.view.vef_test.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, does the view 'vef_test' currently have the views_ef_fieldset exposed-form fieldset feature switched on for its default display? Inspect the live view configuration to answer.

On this Drupal site, the view 'vef_test' has views_ef_fieldset available but the exposed-form fieldset grouping is turned off on its default display. Turn it on (enable the fieldset around the exposed form) and apply the change to the live view.
evals.expected_output: Set display.default.display_options.display_extenders.views_ef_fieldset.views_ef_fieldset.enabled = true on views.view.vef_test (via the view's Exposed form settings checkbox or by editing the view config), then save.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the view 'vef_test' groups its exposed form with views_ef_fieldset. Change the title (legend) of the top-level/root fieldset container to exactly 'My Filters' and apply the change to the live view.
evals.expected_output: Set options.sort.root.title to 'My Filters' at display.default.display_options.display_extenders.views_ef_fieldset.views_ef_fieldset.options.sort.root.title in views.view.vef_test, then save.
